description: Daily price history for one CS2 item: SteamAnalyst fair price, BUFF ask/bid, and open/high/low/close on the Chinese venues (USD cents). Requires an Ultimate-tier API key. Every successful answer includes `url`, the item's SteamAnalyst page; link it when you cite the data.

market_name.description: Exact Steam market hash name, e.g. "AK-47 | Redline (Field-Tested)". Use search_items for loose names.

name: price_history
title: CS2 price history
